items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: it was Jeff, him and I was playing baritone, had Ike Quebec on one tenor and Sam Taylor on the other tenor.

ctx.x: : What's the name of the label? Do you know?
It's on a big, yellow thing. I have it at home happen to know, because I tell you, Jeff got it, pulled it out one day when I was over to Goodies. You know Goodies?
